name: QVI India Private Limited
india_angle: QVI India Private Limited serves as the local representative for OGP, providing product details, demonstrations, training, and purchase information in India.
summary: QVI India Private Limited, representing OGP, specializes in advanced metrology systems for high-speed, high-accuracy industrial inspection. Their 3D multisensor VMM systems are integral to quality control processes in semiconductor manufacturing, offering precision measurement solutions for various end markets.
